max.visual_identity: Young adult male survivor, dark messy short hair, distinctive tired eyes, charcoal grey hooded jacket with faded rust-red seam stripe, dark shirt, brown cargo pants, worn lace-up boots, brown utility backpack. Same face, hairstyle, height, outfit, and silhouette in every shot.

biscuit.visual_identity: Small tan mixed-breed dog with two darker floppy ears, dark muzzle markings, red cloth collar and distinctive cream chest. Consistent canine anatomy and proportions in every shot, never a robot.

ada.visual_identity: Young adult woman survivor with shoulder-length dark hair tied low, olive green field jacket, navy blue scarf, charcoal work trousers, grey boots and a small blue utility bag. Same face and silhouette in every shot.

old.visual_identity: Otto, older male truck driver, weathered face, short silver beard, faded navy work cap, heavy brown canvas jacket, blue jeans. Same face and clothes in every shot.

zombie.visual_identity: Human zombie with pale ashen skin, worn dark clothing, slow unnatural posture and eyes obscured by shadow. Non-graphic survival horror.
